bibliography.title: Enhanced Proton Conductivity from Phosphoric Acid-Incorporated 3D Polyacrylamide-Graft-Starch Hydrogel Materials for High-Temperature Proton Exchange Membranes
bibliography.authors: Correspondence to: Q. Tang (E - mail: tangqunwei@ouc.edu.cn) and X. Wang (E - mail: wangxinhd@ouc.edu.cn)

system_identity.dopant: Phosphoric acid (H3PO4) incorporated/imbibed from 1–9 M aqueous solution then vacuum-dried to anhydrous state.
system_identity.form_factor: Membrane/disc (U 3-cm round-disks) dried under vacuum at 60 °C; used as high-temperature PEM.
system_identity.other: Initiator: ammonium persulfate (APS); porous 3D framework claimed to retain H3PO4 under anhydrous high-temperature conditions (Abstract; Introduction; Experimental).

measurement_scope.temp_range: Up to 180 °C is explicitly reported for conductivity (Abstract).
measurement_scope.other_conditions: H3PO4 uptake performed by soaking in 1–9 M H3PO4(aq) for 20 days to equilibrium, then vacuum-dried at 60 °C to remove water (Experimental).

mechanism_relevant_findings: The membrane’s high-temperature conductivity is described as being dependent on H3PO4 loading retained within a 3D porous PAAm-g-starch framework (Abstract; Introduction).
Increasing NMBA crosslinker and APS initiator dosages is reported to increase H3PO4 loading and thereby increase proton conductivity (Abstract).
The 3D hydrogel framework is stated to provide interconnected microporous space that absorbs and retains H3PO4 even under pressure and in anhydrous operation (Introduction).

numerical_findings.conditions: 180 °C; fully anhydrous state; H3PO4-imbibed PAAm-g-starch hydrogel membrane (Abstract).
Immersion at room temperature for 20 days to absorption equilibrium (Experimental).
24 h for dried membranes; additional drying after acid incorporation to remove water (Experimental).

limitations: No EIS frequency range, equivalent circuit, or Nyquist/Bode shape information is provided in the provided excerpt.
No Arrhenius/VTF fitting, activation energy, or temperature-dependent functional form is provided in the provided excerpt.
The excerpt does not specify whether reported conductivity is in-plane or through-plane nor the measurement protocol.

relevance_judgement.reason: The excerpt reports high anhydrous proton conductivity and composition/processing parameters but does not include EIS/Arrhenius/VTF mechanistic analysis details.
